description: This file provides utility function declarations, macros, and inline functions for buffer management, byte order encoding/decoding, memory allocation, and other miscellaneous utilities used in the reftable component of a Git-related project.

methods.name: reftable_buf_init
methods.description: Initializes a reftable buffer for use.

methods.name: reftable_buf_release
methods.description: Releases memory associated with a buffer and reinitializes it.

methods.name: reftable_buf_reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer length without releasing memory.

methods.name: reftable_buf_setlen
methods.description: Sets the buffer length, writing a NUL byte at the new end.

methods.name: reftable_buf_addstr
methods.description: Appends a string to the buffer.

methods.name: reftable_buf_detach
methods.description: Detaches the buffer's memory for caller ownership.

methods.name: reftable_put_be16
methods.description: Encodes a 16-bit integer in big-endian order.

methods.name: reftable_put_be24
methods.description: Encodes a 24-bit integer in big-endian order.

methods.name: reftable_put_be32
methods.description: Encodes a 32-bit integer in big-endian order.

methods.name: reftable_put_be64
methods.description: Encodes a 64-bit integer in big-endian order.

methods.name: common_prefix_size
methods.description: Finds the length of the longest common prefix of two buffers.

methods.name: hash_size
methods.description: Returns the size of a hash based on the hash ID.
